output_list.criticism: The function claimTile is the entry point for users to claim tiles. It is public and can be called by anyone. This makes it vulnerable to front-running attacks, rug-pulls, and other malicious actions. The game balance is directly added to the msg.sender's balance, which can be used to drain the contract.
